title: WSJ opinion column defends OpenAI agents in context of HuggingFace security incident

WSJ opinion column defends OpenAI agents in context of HuggingFace security incident

A Wall Street Journal opinion column defended OpenAI's AI agents in the context of the HuggingFace security incident. The column argued that the incident highlighted the need for better security practices rather than abandoning AI agent development.
